passage:
**Rice harvest of four provinces by season, 2025** (in thousands of metric tons)

| Province | Wet season | Dry season |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Province P | 100 | 60 |
| Province Q | 50 | 70 |
| Province R | 45 | 35 |
| Province S | 25 | 15 |
stem: For the four provinces together, how much more rice was harvested in the wet season than in the dry season?
hints: Read the title: the numbers are in thousands of metric tons. You need a total for each season.
Add the Wet season column, then add the Dry season column.
Subtract the dry season total from the wet season total. Then change thousands of metric tons into metric tons.

solution.methodName: Find the values, then add or subtract

steps.why: "How much more" means find the difference.

steps.action: Use the units in the title: 40 thousand metric tons = 40 × 1,000 = 40,000 metric tons.
The wet season harvest was 40,000 metric tons more than the dry season harvest.

trapNotes.40 metric tons: The difference is 40, but the table is in thousands of metric tons. 40 thousand is 40,000 metric tons.
trapNotes.400,000 metric tons: This adds the two totals (220 + 180 = 400). "How much more" means subtract.
trapNotes.30,000 metric tons: This leaves out Province S (25 and 15). Add all four rows in each column.
